formula_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(created_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) AS month,
  transaction_type,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
  SUM(total_tcs_amount) AS tcs,
  SUM(total_tds) AS tds
FROM zs_observe.jiomart_oms
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
